data.gender_notes: Qurrat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qurrat is an Arabic name that means 'consolation' or 'comfort'. It is also the name of a chapter in the Quran, Surat al-Qurrat, which means 'the chapter of comfort'. In Islamic tradition, Qurrat is a name that symbolizes solace and peace. The name Qurrat carries the meaning “Consolation, Comfort” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qurrat usually hope their child will grow to embody consolation, comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Qurrat is a reminder of Allah's mercy and comfort in times of hardship, as mentioned in Surat al-Qurrat.
data.etymology: Qurrat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Consolation, Comfort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qurrat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
